name: multipart-parser
description: A lightweight parser for decoding multipart/form-data request payloads and extracted file attachments.
aiPromptContext: Use this block inside zero-dependency HTTP server request controllers to parse incoming multipart/form-data upload values and files.

parameters.name: bodyBuffer
parameters.description: Raw body Buffer bytes of the incoming request.

parameters.name: boundary
parameters.description: Boundary separation string extracted from the Content-Type header.
